'''Misty's special lure''' is a {{wp|fishing lure}} created by {{an|Misty}} to help with her [[fishing]] for {{type|Water}} Pokémon. It is a small model of Misty herself in {{wp|Chibi (style)|chibi}} style. She believes it to be the best in her collection of lures, and gets sensitive when {{Ash}} is skeptical of this. It appears to have undergone many redesigns, or she otherwise may have multiple lures of herself, but most versions depict Misty in her original outfit.

==History==
Misty's special lure debuted in the [[Banned episodes|banned episode]] [[EP035]], alongside six other lures, including a {{p|Poliwag}}, {{p|Psyduck}}, {{p|Seel}}, {{p|Magikarp}}, {{p|Charmander}}, and {{p|Goldeen}} lure. "The Misty Special" debuted internationally in ''[[EP091|Bye Bye Psyduck]]''.

Misty has used the lure herself several times, like when she was trying to catch a {{AP|Totodile}} in ''[[EP151|The Totodile Duel]]''; and during the [[Seaking Catching Competition]] in ''[[EP168|Hook, Line, and Stinker]]''.

Misty asked {{an|Professor Oak}} to deliver a lure to Ash as a gift when he met him in ''[[AG187|The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!]]''. During said episode, it was again referred to as "Misty's Special". Ash later used it to fish for a {{AP|Buizel}} in ''[[DP034|Buizel Your Way Out Of This!]]'', and when {{an|Dawn}} asked to use it, he refused, leading to a short squabble between the two. Later in the episode, Buizel stole their rods, including Ash's with the lure attached; however, it was later recovered.

In ''[[SM120|The One That Didn't Get Away!]]'', {{an|Lana}} was revealed to have received a lure of her own from Misty as a gift. She covered it with [[Antidote]]-laced food to cure a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Kyogre}} that had been {{status|poison}}ed by [[Hunter D]], who was aiming to steal it.

In ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]'', Misty used her lure in an attempt to catch a {{TP|Misty|Clauncher}} that Ash was also trying to catch. She also mentioned the one that she had previously given to Ash. It reappeared in ''[[JN143|Ride, Lapras, Ride!]]''.
